This contract is NOT a record of the seq0671 gate: every passing check points at output produced by specs/epic-195-a7-compatibility/verification/qg-backfill/run-checks.sh at the current HEAD. The red/green pair recorded on the two test checks is historical and stays so on purpose -- red-preimplementation.log was captured before the suite existed and cannot be honestly re-created afterwards; required_workflow is acceptance-first, so check-contract does not validate those two fields, but check-traceability does validate both paths through REQ-001's evidence array in traceability.json. Risk medium and Required Workflow acceptance-first are transcribed from tasks.md#T-003. Full rationale: specs/epic-195-a7-compatibility/verification/qg-backfill/README.md.

checks.waiver_reason: stack: shell -- T-003's deliverables are the POSIX-shell/PowerShell twins tests/compatibility-byte-identical.tests.{sh,ps1} plus edits to the install and uninstall suites. This repository configures no shell linter (no shellcheck and no PSScriptAnalyzer invocation in tests/run-all.{sh,ps1} or .github/workflows/test.yml), so there is no lint command whose output could be recorded. risk-gate-matrix.md Stack descriptor.
stack: shell -- shell and PowerShell are untyped and this repository configures no static type-check command for either runtime. risk-gate-matrix.md Stack descriptor.

No service or network integration is in T-003's scope. The suite's cross-surface comparison reads two live product contracts from the working tree and compares a git-archive capture of a pinned commit; that is file-level comparison, exercised end to end by the acceptance suite, not a separate integration layer.

stack: shell -- no compile or bundle step exists for shell/PowerShell test suites; there is no dist/ artifact and design.md's Deployment / CI Plan records no build obligation for this task. risk-gate-matrix.md Stack descriptor.

No independently startable application, service, or UI: the deliverable is a registered test suite whose only entry point is the suite runner itself, which the acceptance evidence records in both runtimes.

No baseline-behavior.md exists for this feature and T-003 is a new additive suite rather than a change to existing behavior, so no differential obligation attaches (references/differential-test-policy.md). The byte-identity oracle the suite compares against is T-002's canonical golden baseline, not a differential baseline for T-003's own change.
No user-facing UI surface. traceability.md's Layer Coverage records UX and Frontend as reasoned N/A for the whole feature: 'no GUI, view, dialog, menu item, or human interactive shell surface'.

ds_profile: none -- this repository carries no design-system/ directory and T-003 touches no UI-layer file, so check-design-system's warn-phase conditional control does not activate (risk-gate-matrix.md footnote 4).
